name: unbounce-native
description: Design and build natively-editable Unbounce landing pages — real lp-pom-* elements the client can edit in the drag-and-drop editor, never one raw-HTML blob.

unbounce_api_key.title: Unbounce API key
unbounce_api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to design and build .unbounce files offline; supply it to also upload and edit pages in an Unbounce account. From Unbounce: Settings > API keys. Stored in the OS keychain, never in this repo.
